findings.issue: FunnelNote.text is typed as `string` (non-optional, non-nullable) but there is no corresponding runtime guard or compile-time enforcement preventing an empty string from being sent. While the task scope is types-only, a downstream consumer constructing a FunnelNote with text:'' would pass TypeScript checks and produce a semantically invalid note. A branded type or explicit JSDoc constraint would surface the intent without adding runtime code.
findings.fix: Add a JSDoc comment on the `text` field noting it must be non-blank (mirrors backend @NotBlank expectation from NoteDto). This is documentation-only and in scope for this task: `/** Non-blank note body (@NotBlank server-side). */`

summary: Task 2 is a foundation task adding Vue Flow/dagre dependencies and TypeScript type extensions only. No behavioral logic was introduced; the testing posture of relying on `pnpm typecheck` + `pnpm build` as the sole verification gate is correct and fully adequate for this scope. All five acceptance-criteria type additions (CanvasPosition, FunnelNote, canvasPosition on FunnelStep/FunnelTrigger, notes on FunnelResponse/UpdateFunnelRequest) are present and structurally correct — optional, nullable, additive, non-breaking. SSR plumbing is minimal and correct: CSS import added to the css[] array, no global ssr:false introduced, no premature client-only wrapper. The one minor finding is a documentation gap on FunnelNote.text that would help consuming tasks (Task 4, Task 7) understand the non-blank contract without needing to read the backend source. No blockers or major issues found.

litmusTest.note: No unit tests exist by design; litmus test not applicable to pure type/dep additions

pyramidBalance.assessment: N/A — build-time type checking is the correct and sufficient verification gate for this task type
